sources.entry: UI Craft by Eduardo Calvo - A deep design-engineering skill that makes agents "design like they have taste" by default, layered so you can just install it, drive it with 22 single-lens commands, or wire its deterministic MCP gates and CLI into CI. Its signature is a *scoreable, defensible* critique — Nielsen's heuristics × classic design laws × persona walkthroughs, every finding tagged by busines

summary.one_liner: UI Craft is a design-engineering skill, CLI, and MCP/CI toolkit that makes AI coding agents produce polished, non-generic UI and gives deterministic and judged design-quality scores.
summary.what_it_does: Installs as an agent skill (via a Go CLI, Claude Code plugin, Cursor plugin, or npx skills add) that pushes AI coding agents toward opinionated design craft: hierarchy, tokens, motion rules, and an anti-slop list. It provides 25 slash commands grouped into four "rungs" (ask, direct passes like /craft and /polish, persistent brief and tokens, and enforcement via /finalize), plus two read-only review agents (design-reviewer, a11y-auditor). A zero-dependency detector (ui-craft-detect) scans code or live URLs for 43 anti-pattern rules, supports diff-scoped scanning, agent edit-time hooks, and a GitHub Action for PR feedback. The README also describes MCP quality gates (check_anti_slop, tokens_lint, acceptance_bar, score_ui) and a deterministic UICraftScore (0-100) plus a judged UsabilityScore built from a Nielsen/design-law heuristic scorecard.
use_cases: Having an AI coding agent build dashboards, landing pages, or auth screens that look production-ready
Running a scored UX and design critique of an existing interface
Enforcing anti-AI-slop and accessibility checks in CI or pre-commit hooks
Scanning a deployed URL for common UI and accessibility anti-patterns
Keeping design tokens and a durable design brief consistent across agent sessions
Adding per-edit design feedback to Claude Code or Cursor agents
how_to_run: curl -fsSL | bash  (macOS/Linux installer; URL omitted in README text)
stack: Optional: puppeteer for live URL scanning
notable: Scoreable, defensible critique: Nielsen's 10 heuristics, 6 design laws, and 5 persona walkthroughs, with findings tagged by business impact
Ladder structure from zero-effort use up to CI-enforced gates, so users only adopt what they need
Deterministic 0-100 UICraftScore computed from anti-slop, token, and a11y findings
Diff-scoped detector (--scope changed) and `ci install` that posts sticky PR comments and inline review comments
Edit-time hooks that feed anti-slop findings back to Claude Code and Cursor agents while they work
caveats: The README states macOS Intel and Linux arm64 and Windows arm64 binaries are built but not tested; Intel macOS is called the largest remaining gap
Agent Skills install (npx skills add) gives only the skill and commands, with no review agents, MCP gates, or hooks; global installs for Claude Code need a symlink workaround
Live URL scanning with full JS rendering requires optional puppeteer install; the fetch fallback sees only server-delivered HTML
